agencyWord.body2: As specialists in the Kénitra market, we guide a discerning clientele in the search for exceptional residences. Our exclusive network gives us access to unique off-market properties.

about.body: For over 15 years, Majestic Keys has guided a discerning clientele in acquiring and enhancing exceptional properties in Kénitra and beyond.
about.metaDescription: Discover Majestic Keys, a prestige real estate agency in Kénitra: our story, our values and our tailor-made approach.

story.title: One vision, a lasting legacy
story.body: Majestic Keys was born in Kénitra from a simple conviction: prestige real estate deserves an approach equal to its demands. Far from standardised transactions, we built a human-scale agency where every file is handled with the rigour and discretion of a genuinely bespoke service.
story.body2: Over the years our network has extended into the kingdom's most sought-after neighbourhoods, giving us access to rare properties that are often invisible on the open market. That closeness to the ground, combined with sharp legal and tax expertise, makes us the trusted partner of a demanding Moroccan and international clientele.

values.title: What defines us
values.excellenceBody: Rigorous selection and flawless execution at every stage of your project.
values.discretionBody: Your transactions are handled in complete confidence, away from prying eyes.
values.efficiencyBody: Responsive, direct support that turns your ambitions into reality at the right pace.

team.body: A small, dedicated team of advisors, negotiators and specialists guiding every step of your property journey in Kénitra and beyond.

services.body: From the first viewing to the signature and well beyond, Majestic Keys brings its expertise to every stage of your property project.
